lessons.title: IAM in one sentence
lessons.summary: IAM is a way of preserving coherent identity while intentions move through changing tools, contexts, and forms of action.

lessons.title: Power has boundaries
lessons.summary: An IAM-aligned system does not assume unlimited access. Capabilities are granted explicitly, kept proportionate, and made reviewable.

lessons.title: Meaning and evidence have different jobs
lessons.summary: Mythic language can help people interpret purpose and values. Evidence, policy, contracts, and explicit permission govern factual and operational claims.

lessons.title: Build relationships before complexity
lessons.summary: Complex systems become understandable when their parts, inputs, outputs, and transformations remain visible.

lessons.title: A practical reading of IAM
lessons.summary: IAM joins identity, bounded agency, visible relationships, stewardship, and optional mythic interpretation into one public teaching frame.
